content: Kakuwu kemɨtiyuta'unaxɨ Rawani hetsɨa
Hikɨ Kakuwu mɨpaɨ katiniuyumarieni kename Rawani niwemama mɨpaɨ me'utiyuanekai: «Kakuwu naime katinepiini tapaapa tewamama, piiniteyakɨ waɨkawa rexeiyatɨ kanayuyeitɨani».
Yaxeikɨata Kakuwu katinetimani Rawani 'aixɨari mɨkatixeiyakaikɨ meripaitɨ kemɨkatixeiyakai.
Hikɨ Yawé Kakuwu mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: «Kenakunua 'apaapa kwieyatsie, hakewa 'a'iwama meme'uwa, ne 'ahamatɨa nepuyeikani».
Hikɨ Kakuwu katiniutanɨ'ani yu'ɨitama Xakeri meta Reya wahekɨ, muxatsi mɨwarahɨnetsie paitɨ,
mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Mɨpaɨ nepɨtimate xepaapa 'aixɨa pɨkanetixeiyari meripaitɨ hepaɨ. Peru tsepa, nepaapa Kakaɨyarieya pɨnetsiparewie.
Xeme xekatenimaika kenemɨtiuta'uximayataxɨ xepaapa Rawani hetsiemieme neyutatuatɨ yuheyemekɨ.
Peru mɨkɨ matsi mɨixa pɨnetsi'ukwamanaxɨ, waɨkawa 'ikupatatɨ ne'iwarika. Peru Kakaɨyari pɨka'ipitɨa 'axamɨnetsiyurienikɨ.

Kepauka mɨpaɨ mɨnetikɨhɨawekai: «Yunaitɨ tewaxi memeupipitu 'a'iwarika mepakɨne», 'ana 'ukari yunaitɨ mepɨwatiniweyakai meheupipitume xeikɨa. Kepaukata mɨpaɨ mɨnetikɨhɨawekai: «Yunaitɨ tewaxi memeuririnawi 'a'iwarika mepakɨne», 'ana 'ukari yunaitɨ mepɨwatiniweyakai meheuririnawime xeikɨa.
Mɨpaɨ Kakaɨyari xepaapa tewamamata katiniunawairieni, nepɨta kanetiniupitɨani.
»Merikɨtsɨ kepauka tewaxi mematiniweiyatsie 'ana mɨpaɨ nekatiniuheinɨni. 'Ukitsi mekaniwaweiyatɨwekaitɨni 'ukari, memeuririnawi meta memeupipitu.
Mɨkɨ heinɨtsikatsie meta niuki tuayame Kakaɨyari hetsɨa mieme, mɨpaɨ kanetiniutahɨawe: “Kakuwu”. 'Ana mɨpaɨ nekatinita'eiya: “'Ena nepuyeika”.
Hikɨ mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ kanetiniutahɨawe: “Paratsɨ keneuyɨ'ɨwiya, tuurutsixi 'ukari memɨwaweiyatɨwe mekaneuririnawini meta mekaneupipitɨni. Ne nepɨtimate kemɨmatsi'uyuri Rawani.

Ne Kakaɨyari nekanihɨkɨtɨni Weteri nemunehekɨataxɨ, hakewa mawari pemewewi nehetsiemieme tetetsie, meta kepemainekai nehɨxie. 'Ayumieme kenanukukexi 'ikɨ kwieyaritsie, kenemie kemɨ'ane kwieyaritsie pemetinuiwaxɨ”».
Xakeri Reya matɨa mɨpaɨ mekatenita'eiya: —Tixaɨtɨri tame pɨkatatikupinierie tapaapa tahetsie timieme.
Matsi mɨkatatsimateni hepaɨ pɨtatixeiya. Pɨtatsi'utua, mɨkɨ naimeri pɨtiutixɨtɨa tita mɨrakapitɨarie tahetsiemieme.
Kaniyuritɨni Kakaɨyari naime mɨtinawairi tapaapa mɨrexeiyakai tahetsiemieme katinihɨkɨtɨni meta tatɨɨriyama wahetsiemieme. 'Ayumieme yaketineuyuri Kakaɨyari kemɨmarahɨawe.
Hikɨ Kakuwu kaniyukuha'aritɨani, yuniwema yu'ɨitama kaniwaranutiyatsa kameyutsixi wahetsie.
Yunaime tiwara'arietɨ yutewama Parani-'Arami mɨtiukaxeiyakai, mekanekɨne Kanani me'erietɨ, 'ukiyarieya 'Itsahaki manukateitsie.
Mexi Rawani yumuxatsima warexinekai, Xakeri yapauka heyaka kaniwarunawani kakaɨyariximama.
Mɨpaɨ katinikwamana Kakuwu Rawani 'arameu tewiyari, kaniuyuta'una 'atsikatitahɨaweka.
Kakuwu kaneyani yunaime tiwara'arietɨ tita mɨrexeiyakai. 'Epɨrata hatuxameyaritsie 'uyeyaka, muhɨriyatsie Karaha kanitiyune.
Rawani Kakuwu kemɨranukuweiyaxɨ
Hairieka tukari 'anukayaku Rawani katiniutaxatɨarieni, kename Kakuwu 'uyuta'unakai.
Hikɨ Rawani kaniwarukuxeɨrieni yu'iwamarixi, mɨkɨ mekaniwaranukuweiya 'atahuta tukari mekaniuhukaitɨni, mekaniwaranuku'axeke Karaha hɨriyaritsie paitɨ.
Perutsɨ mɨkɨ tɨkaritsie Kakaɨyari Rawani 'arameu tewiyari katiniutaxatɨani kutsukaku mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «'Amarima 'aixɨa Kakuwu pepɨka'utate'ani».
Rawani Kakuwu kaniwaranuku'axe Karaha hɨriyaritsie mɨkɨ mana me'uxipiekaku. Metatsiere Rawani mana kaniyuhayewa yu'iwama warawitɨtɨ.
Mɨpaɨ Kakuwu katiniutahɨawe: —¿Kepetiuyuri 'aku? Pekanetiniu'itaiya, neniwema pekaniwareyewitɨni pɨretsutsixi wahepaɨ.
¿Ketitayari pereyetɨa 'atsipekaneretahɨaweka? Ne 'aixɨa 'anemekɨ nekamenetateutɨanikekaitɨni neyutemawietɨ ne xawererutsixi nepɨwareta'inienikekai.
Tsikere neniwema nemɨwareti'itsenikekai pepɨkanetsihepitɨa meta neteukarima. Pemɨka'uka'iyarini hepaɨ pepeyɨ.
Ne nekaniyɨweni nemɨtixe'utikwinitɨani, peru 'ikɨ tɨkaritsie 'apaapa Kakaɨyarieya pɨneretaxatɨa mɨpaɨ pɨneretahɨawixɨ: “'Amarima 'aixɨa Kakuwu pepɨka'utate'ani”.
Mɨpaɨ nepɨretima 'apaapa manuyeikatsie peyeimɨtɨ pepɨyɨane, ¿peru ketitayari petiwarenawa nekakaɨyarixi?
Kakuwu mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Ne yemekɨ waɨkawa ne petima, mɨpaɨ nepɨre'eri ne'ɨitama penetsihenawairienike nepe'eriekai.

Keniwarutiwawa 'akakaɨyarixi, kemɨ'ane pemɨtaxeirieni mɨkɨ ke'ukumawere. Ta'iwama memunenierixɨ mekanakɨnikuni: Ketineutiwawa tita mɨti'apiini, ketinapitɨ. Perutsɨ Kakuwu 'atsipɨkatimaikai, Xakeri Rawani kakaɨyariximama mɨwarenawakai,

Hikɨ Rawani Kakuwu xamaruyata meri kaniuti'iwauni, kwitɨwata Reya xamaruyata meta memɨyuhuta te'uximayatamete 'ukarawetsixi waxamaruta, nitixaɨtɨ pɨkatiukaxei. Kepauka Reya xamaruyata mɨwayetɨa, Xakeri xamaruyata kaneutahani.
Hikɨ Xakeri kakaɨyarixi kaniwaruti'awieta kameyu xirayatɨa, mɨpaɨ tiuyurieka waheima kanayerɨni. Rawani naime kaniu'iwauxiwiya, mɨkɨ pɨkawarutaxei.

Hikɨ Xakeri yupaapa mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —Neuxeitsɨ, nepɨtikuye, nepaapa, 'ukarawetsixi ketemɨyɨtɨka mɨpaɨ nepɨ'ane, nepɨkayɨwe 'anemutakeni pepɨkaha'aka. Rawani kakaɨyarixi kaniwarutiwauni, peru pɨkawarutaxei.
Merikɨtsɨ Kakuwu kaniuyeha'ani, Rawani hepaɨtsita mɨpaɨ katinenutahɨawixɨani: —¿Kekuta yemekɨ netiuyuri, xurikime nekapeutiwiwiexɨa, titayari mɨya petatiyuriene?
Nepiinite naime pemɨtiutixei, ¿tita petiukaxei mɨti'apiini? Xɨka tixaɨtɨ petiutaxeiya, ta'iwama wahɨxie ketinekupini, mɨkɨ yameke'utiyuani kemɨ'ane tame temɨtahuta heitserie pexeiya.
Xeitewiyari wiyari 'ahetsɨa nepuyeikakai, 'amuxatsima 'atsipurima hatsuaku mepɨka'anuye'ikwitɨaxɨa, nitɨma xeime muxa nepɨka'utakwai 'akurarutamieme.
Xeime hatsuaku nepɨka'atɨa 'ɨrawe 'itexierieya, nepɨta nepɨrayukatuayakai mɨkɨkɨ. Yaxeikɨata hekɨta tɨkarikɨ memɨnawarietɨwekai 'ekɨ mɨkɨkɨ pepɨnetsiwiyakai.
Tukarikɨ xɨrikɨ nepɨtiuka'eniwakai, tɨkarikɨ xerikɨ neputimɨmɨwekaitɨma, yemekɨ nepɨkatikukutsukai.
Xeitewiyari wiyari 'akie nepuyuri, tamamata heimana nauka wiyari nepɨti'uximayakai 'aniwema wahetsiemieme, 'ataxewime wiyari 'atewama nepuwahɨkai, peru 'ekɨ mɨixa pepipataxɨ kenemɨti'iwakai.

Xɨka nepaapa Kakaɨyarieya 'Itsahaki meyemakaxe, meta 'Apɨrahami Kakaɨyarieya, xɨka kanetsiparewiekake, 'ekɨ nemaweme pekanenanunɨ'anikekaitɨni. Kakaɨyari pɨnetsi'uxei kenemɨtiuka'eniwakai neti'uximayatɨ, 'ayumieme takai tɨkarikɨ kename ne heitserie nehexeiya putayɨ.

Rawani Kakuwu mɨpaɨ katiniuta'eiya: —'Ikɨ 'ukari mepɨneniwema, 'ikɨ temari mepɨneteukarima, muxatsitsiere mepɨnetewama, tita pemɨrexeiya nepiini pɨtihɨkɨ naitɨ. ¿Ketsukuta newaruyurieni 'ikɨ neniwema neteukarima?
Matsi tɨratu tepɨwewieni 'ekɨ matɨa ne, mɨkɨ tɨratu teme'eriwanikɨ mɨpaɨ temɨtemaikakɨ.
Hikɨ Kakuwu tete 'anukutuka 'akanitakeni 'inɨari hepaɨ,
mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe yu'iwama: —Tetexi xekeneukuxeɨri. Mɨkɨ mepititɨkixɨa, 'axeikɨa mepikuxeɨri, mana mepɨte'ukwai, tetexi makuxeɨrietsie.
Mana Rawani Yekaxi-Tsaruta katiniuterɨwa meta Kakuwu Karaha katiniterɨwa.
Rawani mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —'Ikɨ tetexi 'ena mukuxeɨrie teme'eriwanikɨ pɨ'inɨaritɨni. 'Ayumieme mana Karaha pɨtiuterɨwarɨwakai,
metatsiere Mitsipa pɨtiuterɨwarɨwakai, Rawani mɨpaɨ mutayɨkɨ: —Yawé ketatsixeiyani kepauka tahamatɨa temɨka'u'uwanitsie tame teyuhutatɨ.
Xɨka 'ekɨ neniwema 'axapewareyurieneni, xɨka hipame pɨta pewaretiwitɨni 'ukari, kena'eriwani Kakaɨyari yapɨretima, tsepa xewitɨ tawarita mɨkatatsixeiya.
Rawani tetexi 'itɨiyatɨ mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Keneuxeiya tetexi mukuxeɨrie meta tete temikake.
Mɨkɨ ya'ane mepɨmaika kename 'ekɨ meta ne 'ena teka'anuyekɨkani 'axatetatiyuriexɨanike.
'Apɨrahami Kakaɨyarieya meta Nakuxi Kakaɨyarieya ta'itsɨkame kehɨkɨtɨni. Hikɨ Kakuwu 'aixɨa kaniutayɨni Kakaɨyari hepaɨtsita paapaya 'Itsahaki mimakaxekai hetsie.
Hikɨ mawari kaniuwewieni yemuri 'amanutitewatsie paitɨ, yu'iwama waruta'inieka yunaitɨ memɨtehekwanikɨ. Yunaitɨ mete'ukwakari, mana mekanitiheteitɨni.
'Uxa'arieka ximeripaitɨ Rawani 'anukukeka, yuteukarima kaniwaruti'itseni Yawé wawirietɨ 'aixɨa mɨwayuriekakɨ meta yuniwema, hikɨ nakunuani yukie.

footnotes.text: Yekaxi-Tsaruta 'arameukɨ paine meta hepɨrayukɨ Karaha, 'inɨari mɨtihekɨatapanuyɨne.
